title: rubus foliosus subsp. pinicola
intro: Rubus foliosus subsp. pinicola, commonly known as the dwarf raspberry or mountain dewberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus foliosus plant, which is a type of wild raspberry native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and fever, due to its health benefits of aiding in digestion and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rubus foliosus subsp. pinicola include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
